trigger: same-key replay produces a second durable effect
tenant or authorization negative reaches PostgreSQL
revision CAS overwrites a newer row
history, audit, outbox or ledger is outside the authority transaction
unknown commit is surfaced as a definitive failure
asset event reaches a noncanonical topic
steps: stop the new intake path or keep it default-off; do not delete authority rows
restore the prior compatible function implementation at the authorized AST nodes only
retain and reconcile any committed asset, history, audit, outbox and ledger rows by tenant and idempotency identity
replay pending outbox rows only through the canonical asset.events.v2 publisher
rerun tenant, idempotency, CAS, crash-matrix and broker-ACK oracles on the same candidate/profile/environment
irreversible_boundary: PostgreSQL commit; after this point use same-key receipt recovery and reconciliation, not destructive rollback
success_oracles: no authority row, audit fact or immutable evidence is deleted
prior compatible path passes all required negative and reconciliation checks
pending and published outbox states agree with real broker ACK outcomes
